literal_meaning: না হয় (শব্দশঃ: না + হয়, অর্থাৎ 'না হওয়া' বা 'ঘটনা না ঘটা')
figurative_meaning_en: at most or in the worst case
example_sentences_in_english: At most, it will cost a hundred rupees.
note: This idiom is a colloquial expression used to indicate a concession or upper limit in informal speech.
